semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 2.1 General safety information

For the secure operation of your medical device, it is the responsibility of the system owner to ensure that each person who operates the system reads and understands the provided Instructions for Use.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
2 Safety information
WARNING
Not observing the Instructions for Use and the safety information of the medical device and the equipment!
Injury to the patient or personnel, and damage to the equipment.
◆ Always observe the Instructions for Use of the particular units used. This includes the labels applied on the equipment as well as the Instructions for Use documents.
◆ Always use this Instructions for Use document in conjunction with all Instructions for Use documents provided.
◆ Follow the safety instructions and safety signs.
◆ For references purposes, store the Instructions for Use near your workplace.
Electronic Instructions for Use are provided on your CT system and on the workplace.

section.title: Monitor ceiling system
section.hierarchy_path: /Safety information/Safety information on patient transport and positioning/Accessories/Furniture/Monitor ceiling system

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Monitor ceiling system
Observe the following safety information when using the monitor ceiling system.
WARNING
Liquids in the monitor ceiling system, power supply cables are laid inside!
Electric shock
◆ Make sure that no liquids, for example cleaning fluids, can get into the interior of the monitor ceiling system.
WARNING
Cleaning and disinfection of parts of the system while the system is connected to the power supply!
Electric shock due to possible contact with line voltage.
◆ Always switch the system off at the main power switch before cleaning and disinfecting.
CAUTION
Raising and moving the monitor ceiling system!
Damage to the monitor ceiling system.
◆ Do not use force when moving the device into the limit positions.
◆ Make sure that the monitor ceiling system does not collide with other components.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 46
2 Safety information
CAUTION
Dirt and liquid in the monitor arm of the ceiling mounted monitor!
Infection possible
◆ Clean the monitor and monitor arm after use.
CAUTION
Raising and moving the monitor ceiling system!
Injury to the personnel, damage to monitor ceiling system.
◆ Do not use force when moving the device into the limit positions.Make sure that the ceiling system does not collide with other components.
WARNING
Malfunction of the system or the equipment!
Injury to the patient or personnel, unintended radiation exposure or damage to the equipment.
◆ Press a STOP key at any unintentional system movement and in any hazardous situation.
◆ Press an EMERGENCY OFF key if the system does not respond to the STOP keys in any hazardous situation.
◆ Shut down the system immediately if system malfunctions are detected and notify the Customer Service at Siemens Healthineers.

section.title: Positioning the arm supports
section.hierarchy_path: /Examination/Positioning the patient/Preparing the patient table/Positioning the mattress/Positioning the arm supports

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Positioning the arm supports
The arm supports are placed under the patient and fixed by the patient's weight. The arm supports should be positioned outside the scan area, if possible.
CAUTION
Use of the mattress with flat surface!
Contusion of patient's fingers during table movement.
◆ Always use both arm supports with the mattress with flat surface.
◆ Observe that the hands of the patient are completely covered by the arm support.
◆ Always fix and observe the patient during table movement.
The patient is correctly positioned.
1 Slightly lift the patient at the level of his or her arms.
2 Push the first arm support with its flat side into the space between patient and table.
3 Position the arm support in a way that the patient's arm lies tight and comfortable against his or her body.
4 Ensure that the patient's hand is completely covered by the arm support.
5 Proceed to position the second arm support on the other side of the patient's body similarly.
After finishing the examination, the arm supports must be removed before the patient gets up from the table.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 7.1.1 Activating Bolus Tracking
You can use Bolus Tracking for most of the diagnostic scan modes.

The scan parameters of the diagnostic scan are used to determine the parameter settings of the PreMonitoring and Monitoring scan. If the parameters of the monitoring scan and diagnostic scan differ, the system will increase the delay time between monitoring scans and diagnostic scans.
You can only activate Bolus Tracking if the scan you selected was not examined yet.
1 Select the diagnostic scan entry you want to scan with Bolus Tracking in the chronicle.
2 Right-click the diagnostic scan entry and select Bolus Tracking from the context menu.
All the examination steps required for Bolus Tracking are displayed in the chronicle.

section.title: Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan range
section.hierarchy_path: /Enhanced examination/Cardiac CT/Turbo Flash Spiral Cardiac/Chest Pain/Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan range

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Turbo Flash Spiral Chest Pain scan range

For the chest pain scan protocols, the chest pain FoV and a Chest Pain icon will be displayed in the topogram to show the cardiac or the standard dose range for the scan of the tomogram. Additionally, the recommended FoV is displayed.
The cardiac/standard dose range is always displayed, irrespective of the selected recon range. If you select another scan, the area will not be displayed.
Two areas of potential motion artifacts are marked in the topogram. They show the estimated position in the scan, when the heart motion is most likely to occur.
The recon job, which is displayed with the heart icon next to it, defines the heart region of the scan.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
7 Enhanced examination
Blue box: Spiral scan range
Magenta box: Selected range
White boxes: Non-selected ranges of the selected scan
You cannot delete the cardiac/standard dose recon job. A copy of this recon job will only inherit the normal parameters but not the property for defining the cardiac/ standard dose range.
If you resize the range of the cardiac/standard dose recon job or move it, the values will be adapted.
You can adapt the scan range in the usual way. ( Page 310 Planning an Examination)

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Scrolling through the image stack
Image segment is selected.
The image‑scroll mode is active by default.
1 If the image-scroll mode is currently not active, press the Cursor / Navigation key to activate the image‑scroll mode.
The lower LED lights up.
2 Move the Mouse joystick up or down to scroll through the images.
The joystick direction corresponds to the scroll bar on the screen at the console.
